title: Scripture and Tradition
definition: Scripture and Tradition addresses the relationship between God's written Word and the teachings, practices, and customs passed down through the church.
summary: Tradition can be helpful when it faithfully reflects biblical truth. However, tradition must always remain subject to Scripture, which alone serves as the final authority for doctrine and practice.
christFocus: Jesus challenged traditions that contradicted God's Word while affirming obedience to the Scriptures. True tradition serves Christ best when it points people back to His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Tradition can preserve wisdom, but Scripture must always remain supreme. Every tradition should be tested by God's Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many errors arise when human traditions are elevated above Scripture. The church must continually return to God's Word as its final authority.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Learn from faithful Christians who have gone before you, but always evaluate teachings, customs, and practices by Scripture.
